map.由扭矩与角速度求机械功率 使用指南: Mechanical power from torque and angular velocity guide
map.输入关节输出扭矩 τ 与角速度 ω，工具按 P=τ·ω 计算机械功率，用于校核电: Enter joint output torque tau and angular velocity omega, and the tool computes mechanical power by P = tau x omega, to check whether the motor rating suffices, assess consumption and heating, and match drive units.
map.输入扭矩 τ 与角速度 ω，求机械功率。: Enter torque tau and angular velocity omega to get mechanical power.
map.力矩×角速求功率。: Power from torque times angular velocity.
map.：P=τ·ω=2×10=20W。: : P = tau x omega = 2 x 10 = 20 W.
map.：P=40W，功率与角速成正比。: : P = 40 W, with power proportional to angular velocity.
map.由转动惯量与角加速度求所需扭矩: Required torque from moment of inertia and angular acceleration
map.角度 = (脉宽 − 最小) / (最大 − 最小) × 180°: Angle = (pulse width - minimum) / (maximum - minimum) x 180 degrees
map.τ 用 N·m、ω 用 rad/s，得 W。: Use N*m for tau and rad/s for omega to get W.
map.机械功率除以效率得输入电功率。: Divide mechanical power by efficiency to get input electrical power.
